mapper.select: SELECT DRFT_DOC_SN AS drftDocSn, TMPLAT_CD AS tmplatCd, EMP_ID AS empId, APRVL_FULL_REC_CN AS aprvlFullRecCn, APRVL_FULL_CN AS aprvlFullCn, DRFT_REQST_DT AS drftReqstDt, APRVL_DOC_STTS_CD AS aprvlDocSttsCd, DOC_TTL AS docTtl, APRVL_HOPE_DT AS aprvlHopeDt, APRVL_CMPTN_DT AS aprvlCmptnDt, RTRN_DT AS rtrnDt FROM TB_APRVL_DOC WHERE DRFT_DOC_SN = #{drftDocSn}

SELECT DRFT_DOC_SN AS drftDocSn, TMPLAT_CD AS tmplatCd, EMP_ID AS empId, APRVL_FULL_REC_CN AS aprvlFullRecCn, APRVL_FULL_CN AS aprvlFullCn, DRFT_REQST_DT AS drftReqstDt, APRVL_DOC_STTS_CD AS aprvlDocSttsCd, DOC_TTL AS docTtl, APRVL_HOPE_DT AS aprvlHopeDt, APRVL_CMPTN_DT AS aprvlCmptnDt, RTRN_DT AS rtrnDt FROM TB_APRVL_DOC WHERE DRFT_DOC_SN = #{drftDocSn} FOR UPDATE

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT APRVL_STEP_SN AS aprvlStepSn, DRFT_DOC_SN AS drftDocSn, EMP_ID AS empId, APRVL_MTHD_CD AS aprvlMthdCd, REQ_APRVL_CNT AS reqAprvlCnt, STEP_PRGRS_CD AS stepPrgrsCd, FRST_RGTR_ID AS frstRgtrId, FRST_REG_DT AS frstRegDt, LAST_MDFR_ID AS lastMdfrId, LAST_MDFCN_DT AS lastMdfcnDt, APRVL_ORD AS aprvlOrd FROM TB_APRVL_STEP WHERE DRFT_DOC_SN = #{drftDocSn} ORDER BY APRVL_ORD ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT APRVL_STEP_SN AS aprvlStepSn, DRFT_DOC_SN AS drftDocSn, EMP_ID AS empId, APRVL_MTHD_CD AS aprvlMthdCd, REQ_APRVL_CNT AS reqAprvlCnt, STEP_PRGRS_CD AS stepPrgrsCd, FRST_RGTR_ID AS frstRgtrId, FRST_REG_DT AS frstRegDt, LAST_MDFR_ID AS lastMdfrId, LAST_MDFCN_DT AS lastMdfcnDt, APRVL_ORD AS aprvlOrd FROM TB_APRVL_STEP WHERE DRFT_DOC_SN = #{drftDocSn} AND STEP_PRGRS_CD = '02' ORDER BY APRVL_ORD ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT APRVL_STEP_SN AS aprvlStepSn, DRFT_DOC_SN AS drftDocSn, EMP_ID AS empId, APRVL_MTHD_CD AS aprvlMthdCd, REQ_APRVL_CNT AS reqAprvlCnt, STEP_PRGRS_CD AS stepPrgrsCd, FRST_RGTR_ID AS frstRgtrId, FRST_REG_DT AS frstRegDt, LAST_MDFR_ID AS lastMdfrId, LAST_MDFCN_DT AS lastMdfcnDt, APRVL_ORD AS aprvlOrd FROM TB_APRVL_STEP WHERE DRFT_DOC_SN = #{drftDocSn} AND APRVL_ORD > #{aprvlOrd} ORDER BY APRVL_ORD ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT APRVL_STEP_SN AS aprvlStepSn, EMP_ID AS empId, APRVL_LINE_SN AS aprvlLineSn, DRFT_DOC_SN AS drftDocSn, APRVR_EMP_ID AS aprvrEmpId, APRVL_DT AS aprvlDt, APRVL_PRGRS_CD AS aprvlPrgrsCd, APRVL_RSN AS aprvlRsn, RTRN_RSN AS rtrnRsn FROM TB_APRVL_LINE WHERE APRVL_STEP_SN = #{aprvlStepSn} AND APRVR_EMP_ID = #{aprvrEmpId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_APRVL_LINE WHERE DRFT_DOC_SN = #{drftDocSn} AND APRVL_PRGRS_CD IN ('02', '03')
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_APRVL_LINE SET APRVL_PRGRS_CD = #{aprvlPrgrsCd}, APRVL_DT = NULL, APRVL_RSN = NULL, RTRN_RSN = NULL WHERE DRFT_DOC_SN = #{drftDocSn}
UPDATE TB_APRVL_LINE SET APRVL_PRGRS_CD = '02', APRVL_DT = #{now}, APRVL_RSN = #{aprvlRsn}, APRVR_STAMP_FILE_ID = #{aprvrStampFileId}, RTRN_RSN = NULL WHERE APRVL_LINE_SN = #{aprvlLineSn}
UPDATE TB_APRVL_DOC SET APRVL_DOC_STTS_CD = #{aprvlDocSttsCd}, DRFT_REQST_DT = #{now}, APRVL_CMPTN_DT = NULL, RTRN_DT = NULL WHERE DRFT_DOC_SN = #{drftDocSn}
mapper.sql: SELECT d.DRFT_DOC_SN AS drftDocSn, d.DOC_TTL AS docTtl, d.TMPLAT_CD AS tmplatCd, d.EMP_ID AS empId, drafter.EMP_NM AS drafterEmpNm, ( SELECT LISTAGG(aprvr.EMP_NM, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.APRVL_ORD, l.APRVL_LINE_SN) FROM TB_APRVL_STEP s JOIN TB_APRVL_LINE l ON l.APRVL_STEP_SN = s.APRVL_STEP_SN JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE aprvr ON aprvr.EMP_ID = l.APRVR_EMP_ID WHERE s.DRFT_DOC_SN = d.DRFT_DOC_SN ) AS approverNames, d.DRFT_REQST_DT AS drftReqstDt, d.APRVL_HOPE_DT AS aprvlHopeDt, d.APRVL_DOC_STTS_CD AS aprvlDocSttsCd, ( SELECT MAX(l2.RTRN_RSN) FROM TB_APRVL_LINE l2 WHERE l2.DRFT_DOC_SN = d.DRFT_DOC_SN AND l2.APRVL_PRGRS_CD = '03' ) AS rtrnRsn FROM TB_APRVL_DOC d JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE drafter ON drafter.EMP_ID = d.EMP_ID

WHERE d.APRVL_DOC_STTS_CD = '01' AND cl.APRVR_EMP_ID = #{empId} AND cl.APRVL_PRGRS_CD = '01'
AND (d.DOC_TTL LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR drafter.EMP_NM LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
mapper.select: ORDER BY NVL(d.APRVL_CMPTN_DT, NVL(d.RTRN_DT, d.DRFT_REQST_DT)) DESC, d.DRFT_DOC_SN DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_APRVL_DOC d JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE drafter ON drafter.EMP_ID = d.EMP_ID

JOIN TB_APRVL_STEP cs ON cs.DRFT_DOC_SN = d.DRFT_DOC_SN AND cs.STEP_PRGRS_CD = '02' JOIN TB_APRVL_LINE cl ON cl.APRVL_STEP_SN = cs.APRVL_STEP_SN
ORDER BY d.DRFT_REQST_DT DESC, d.DRFT_DOC_SN DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_APRVL_DOC d JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE drafter ON drafter.EMP_ID = d.EMP_ID JOIN TB_APRVL_STEP cs ON cs.DRFT_DOC_SN = d.DRFT_DOC_SN AND cs.STEP_PRGRS_CD = '02' JOIN TB_APRVL_LINE cl ON cl.APRVL_STEP_SN = cs.APRVL_STEP_SN

ORDER BY ( SELECT MAX(mine2.APRVL_DT) FROM TB_APRVL_LINE mine2 WHERE mine2.DRFT_DOC_SN = d.DRFT_DOC_SN AND mine2.APRVR_EMP_ID = #{empId} AND mine2.APRVL_PRGRS_CD IN ('02', '03') ) DESC, d.DRFT_DOC_SN DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_APRVL_DOC d JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE drafter ON drafter.EMP_ID = d.EMP_ID
mapper.sql:
WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_APRVL_LINE mine WHERE mine.DRFT_DOC_SN = d.DRFT_DOC_SN AND mine.APRVR_EMP_ID = #{empId} AND mine.APRVL_PRGRS_CD = '02' ) AND d.APRVL_DOC_STTS_CD = '02'
AND (d.DOC_TTL LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR drafter.EMP_NM LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
mapper.select: ORDER BY d.APRVL_CMPTN_DT DESC, d.DRFT_DOC_SN DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_APRVL_DOC d JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE drafter ON drafter.EMP_ID = d.EMP_ID

SELECT d.DRFT_DOC_SN AS drftDocSn, d.DOC_TTL AS docTtl, d.TMPLAT_CD AS tmplatCd, d.EMP_ID AS empId, e.EMP_NM AS drafterEmpNm, dept.DEPT_NM AS drafterDeptNm, grd.JOB_GRD_NM AS drafterJobGrdNm, pstn.JOB_PSTN_NM AS drafterJobPstnNm, e.PRFL_IMG_FILE_ID AS prflImgFileId, d.APRVL_FULL_CN AS aprvlFullCn, d.DRFT_REQST_DT AS drftReqstDt, d.APRVL_HOPE_DT AS aprvlHopeDt, d.APRVL_CMPTN_DT AS aprvlCmptnDt, d.RTRN_DT AS rtrnDt, d.APRVL_DOC_STTS_CD AS aprvlDocSttsCd, f.ATCH_FILE_ID AS atchFileId FROM TB_APRVL_DOC d JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE e ON e.EMP_ID = d.EMP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_DEPARTMENT dept ON dept.DEPT_CD = e.DEPT_CD LEFT JOIN TB_JOB_GRADE grd ON grd.JOB_GRD_CD = e.JOB_GRD_CD LEFT JOIN TB_JOB_POSITION pstn ON pstn.JOB_PSTN_CD = e.JOB_PSTN_CD LEFT JOIN TB_APRVL_FILE f ON f.DRFT_DOC_SN = d.DRFT_DOC_SN WHERE d.DRFT_DOC_SN = #{drftDocSn}

SELECT s.APRVL_STEP_SN AS aprvlStepSn, s.APRVL_ORD AS aprvlOrd, s.STEP_PRGRS_CD AS stepPrgrsCd, l.APRVR_EMP_ID AS aprvrEmpId, e.EMP_NM AS aprvrEmpNm, l.APRVL_PRGRS_CD AS aprvlPrgrsCd, l.APRVL_DT AS aprvlDt, l.APRVL_RSN AS aprvlRsn, l.RTRN_RSN AS rtrnRsn, l.APRVR_STAMP_FILE_ID AS aprvrStampFileId FROM TB_APRVL_STEP s JOIN TB_APRVL_LINE l ON l.APRVL_STEP_SN = s.APRVL_STEP_SN JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE e ON e.EMP_ID = l.APRVR_EMP_ID WHERE s.DRFT_DOC_SN = #{drftDocSn} ORDER BY s.APRVL_ORD ASC, l.APRVL_LINE_SN ASC

SELECT t.TMPLAT_CD AS tmplatCd, t.TMPLAT_NM AS tmplatNm, t.TMPLAT_CN AS tmplatCn, t.USE_YN AS useYn, t.ATCH_FILE_ID AS atchFileId, CASE WHEN f.EMP_ID IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS favoriteYn FROM TB_APRVL_TMPLAT t LEFT JOIN TB_APRVL_TMPLAT_FAV f ON f.TMPLAT_CD = t.TMPLAT_CD AND f.EMP_ID = #{empId} WHERE t.TMPLAT_CD = #{tmplatCd} AND t.USE_YN = 'Y'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_APRVL_TMPLAT WHERE TMPLAT_CD = #{tmplatCd} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_APRVL_TMPLAT_FAV (EMP_ID, TMPLAT_CD, FRST_REG_DT) VALUES (#{empId}, #{tmplatCd}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT t.TMPLAT_CD AS tmplatCd, t.TMPLAT_NM AS tmplatNm, t.TMPLAT_CN AS tmplatCn, t.USE_YN AS useYn, t.ATCH_FILE_ID AS atchFileId, CASE WHEN f.EMP_ID IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS favoriteYn FROM TB_APRVL_TMPLAT t LEFT JOIN TB_APRVL_TMPLAT_FAV f ON f.TMPLAT_CD = t.TMPLAT_CD AND f.EMP_ID = #{empId} WHERE t.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY t.FRST_REG_DT DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_APRVL_TMPLAT SET TMPLAT_NM=#{tmplatNm}, TMPLAT_CN=#{tmplatCn}, USE_YN=#{useYn}, LAST_MDFR_ID=#{lastMdfrId}, LAST_MDFCN_DT=#{lastMdfcnDt}, ATCH_FILE_ID=#{atchFileId} WHERE TMPLAT_CD=#{tmplatCd}
